shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
Cooking new recipes is one of my hobbies.
I enjoy going for long walks in the park.
Traveling to new places always excites me.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
I often take photographs when I visit new cities.
Spending time with family is very important to me.
I like to try different cuisines from around the world.
Learning a new language can be challenging but rewarding.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you share a recent trip you planned and how you did it?
Q2: What challenges did you face while planning your trip?
Q3: In your opinion, what makes a trip successful?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: Can you describe an experience that made you more aware of environmental issues?
Q2: What specific challenges do you think people face in being eco-friendly?
Q3: How important do you think it is to protect the environment?
Q4: What actions can individuals take to help the environment?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: How often do you exercise, and what activities do you enjoy?
Q2: Have you ever faced any obstacles to maintaining a consistent exercise routine?
Q3: What do you believe are the benefits of regular exercise?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone looking to start exercising regularly?
